anchors.meaning: Dead target adds kill_exp and reads prior low-word chain, capped at eight.
Applicator converts this target contribution before returning EXP.
A new magic action clears its accumulated EXP and reward totals.
Local magic adds each target return to the same action EXP accumulator.
Zero remaining growth capacity discards EXP, not gold or loot.
Final award applies equipment EXP doubling then adds to actor EXP.
After payout, threshold and growth capacity govern the level-up phase.
Magic marks a kill and increments the chain only on the first kill in the cast.
Own action finish keeps the low word only when a kill mark is present.
A surviving counter target clears the counterattacker chain.
ITEM exp_x2 maps to the exact final-award flag 0x10.
Poison contributes ten per newly added duration unit, after cap nine.
Silence contributes five per newly added duration unit, after cap nine.

limits: Contribution conversion returns normally; final award and kill-state are bounded suffixes before presentation/queue calls.
One spell accumulates per-target EXP and awards once, not a campaign or victory reward pool.
Input actor levels, kill state, contributions and equipment flags are synthetic; source initialization is separate.
